title: Modernize smoke-go CLI/TUI and release workflow
description: Refactor smoke-go into a real Cobra CLI, replace the minimal Bubble Tea prototype with a list/detail TUI, add JSON output and a checked-in sample spec, migrate Beads to the current Dolt-backed flow, and add GoReleaser/release CI/docs updates.

title: Fix GitHub Actions hashFiles workflow parse error
description: Remove unsupported hashFiles expressions from CI workflow so GitHub Actions can parse and run the Go jobs.

title: Bring smoke-go human output closer to legacy smoke.sh
description: Match legacy assertion-oriented CLI output more closely for HTTP checks, including per-assertion OK/FAIL lines and rolled-up totals like the Bash scripts.

title: Clarify smoke-go human CLI pass/fail output
description: Separate transport/check success from assertion failures in ad hoc and YAML CLI output so HTTP 200 does not look like the reason a step failed.

title: Update AGENTS.md for current beads CLI
description: Replace stale bd sync guidance with the current beads export/flush workflow so onboarding and landing-the-plane steps match the installed CLI.

title: Add quick smoke target shorthand
description: Allow a bare target argument such as smoke-go google.com to run a default HTTP smoke check by normalizing the target to a URL, issuing a GET request, and expecting a 200 response, with clear help text and tests.

title: Improve smoke-go CLI help text
description: Make smoke-go --help and subcommand help self-explanatory: explain supported check kinds, YAML spec shape, common examples, and machine-readable output options.

title: Add Makefile for smoke-go workflow
description: Add a certconv-style Makefile so this repo supports make build, make test, and related Go workflow entry points while preserving the legacy Bash test path.

title: Add non-HTTP smoke-go parity (DNS, TLS, TCP)
description: Extend smoke-go beyond HTTP assertions so the Go path can absorb more of the legacy smoke.sh surface. Add declarative DNS query steps, TLS certificate expiry checks, and TCP connectivity probes, with JSON output and TUI result details.

title: Expand BATS coverage for smoke.sh (more offline unit-ish tests)
description:
Expand offline BATS suite for smoke.sh.

Add tests for:
- smoke_tcp_ok (nc + telnet fallback behaviors)
- SMOKE_AFTER_RESPONSE callback invocation
- default response code when headers missing/malformed
- cookie jar args passed to curl
- smoke_form error path (missing form file)
- assertion fail increments + smoke_report output/exit

Done when:
- bats -r _test passes
- pre-commit run -a passes

title: Harden GitHub Actions CI (matrix incl macOS, setup-go for shfmt, go test)
description:
Harden CI workflow.

- ensure Go available (needed by shfmt hook and Go PoC): actions/setup-go

description:
Add additional safe pre-commit hooks (no false positives on JSONL).

Candidates:

title: Fix functional/portability issues: smoke_tcp_ok args; GNU date -d in ssl expiry; safer header reset; macOS tool availability
description:
Fix correctness/portability bugs discovered during review.

Known issues:
- smoke_tcp_ok currently passes host+port as a single arg to telnet
- smoke_assert_ssl_expiry uses GNU date -d, which fails on macOS (BSD date)
- remove_smoke_headers should reset the array rather than unset it
- avoid echo -e; prefer printf

Done when:
- unit tests cover each fix
- no regressions in example scripts

title: Add GitHub Actions workflows to run lint/format checks + BATS tests on PRs
description:
Add GitHub Actions CI to run on PRs and pushes.

Jobs:
- Lint/format (shellcheck + shfmt; fail if formatting differs)
- Tests (bats)

Notes:
- Use pinned action versions
- Keep runtime small; cache where appropriate

Done when:

title: Establish style + lint baseline for Bash (shellcheck, shfmt) and fix current violations
description:
Goal: make all repo shell scripts consistently formatted and clean under shellcheck.

Scope:
- Decide supported shells/OS (bash 3.2+ on macOS; GNU coreutils optional?)

title: Add significant BATS test suite for smoke.sh (unit-ish) and example scripts (integration-ish)
description:

Approach:

- Validate:
  - curl header parsing -> status code extraction
  - request header injection
  - cookie jar behavior (basic)
  - CSRF token substitution
  - assertion pass/fail increments counters
  - smoke_report exit codes

Done when:
- test suite runs offline (no network required)
- CI runs the suite

title: Add pre-commit hooks to enforce formatting/linting (shellcheck/shfmt/etc.)
description:
Add a pre-commit configuration so contributors get fast local feedback.

Hooks:
- shfmt (format)
- shellcheck (lint)
- basic hygiene (e.g., trailing whitespace, EOF)

Done when:
- `pre-commit run -a` passes on a clean checkout

title: Investigate/plan Bubble Tea (Go) CLI port of smoke.sh runner and assertions
description:
Explore a Go implementation using Bubble Tea (TUI) + a CLI runner.

Proposed shape:
- Core engine (Go pkg): loads a test spec, executes steps, records per-step artifacts (status, timings, request/response metadata)
- Frontends:
  - CLI: `smoke run <spec>` with plain output + optional JSON
  - TUI (Bubble Tea): live progress list, per-step details pane, rerun/focus, copy-to-clipboard of failures

Spec format (pick one):
A) YAML spec (recommended): declarative steps + assertions
B) Reuse existing bash scripts by executing them (fast PoC, but loses portability and safety)
C) New DSL (more flexible, more work)

Feature parity mapping:
- HTTP GET/POST + redirects + cookie jar: net/http + cookiejar
- Header assertions: compare response headers
- Body contains/absent: string/regex match
- CSRF token extraction/substitution: regex capture groups + templating
- DNS queries (A/AAAA/NS/etc.) and custom resolver IP: use miekg/dns for raw queries
- TLS cert expiry: crypto/tls + x509, no openssl dependency
- TCP connect: net.DialTimeout

Effort (rough):
- 0.5–1 day: minimal CLI runner + YAML spec + HTTP assertions
- +1–2 days: DNS + TLS + better reporting/JSON
- +2–4 days: Bubble Tea TUI polish (navigation, details, reruns, filtering)

Deliverable for this issue:
- Decide spec format
- Produce a minimal PoC plan and module layout
notes:
Implemented Go PoC: go module + YAML spec loader + HTTP runner + Bubble Tea TUI.

Added:
- cmd/smoke-go (run/tui)
- internal/spec (YAML)
- internal/runner (HTTP assertions)
- internal/tui (Bubble Tea)
- Go tests via httptest

Next (if desired): add DNS/TLS/TCP parity, JSON output, richer TUI details pane.

title: Align smoke-go examples with historical site checks
description: Update smoke-go CLI help and README examples to reference the historical example targets used by this repo, specifically google.com and theregister.com, instead of generic placeholder sites where appropriate.

title: Expand TUI builder into multi-step spec editor
description: Extend the no-spec TUI builder beyond a one-step HTTP check so it can compose multiple steps, cover DNS/TLS/TCP, preview the generated YAML, and save specs to disk before or after running them.
